summary.en: Collective upasana, aarti and mahaprasad on the first Sunday of every month. Newcomers are especially welcome — nothing is expected of you but your presence.
summary.mr: दर महिन्याच्या पहिल्या रविवारी सामूहिक उपासना, आरती व महाप्रसाद.

significance.en: Monthly upasana keeps the practice of the household connected to the practice of the sangha. Families who cannot attend in person join the same upasana on Zoom.

whatToBring.en: Nothing is required. Flowers or fruit for the offering if you wish.
Footwear is left at the entrance; socks are welcome.

summary.en: Our largest annadan of the year, collected at the mandir and distributed in partnership with local Bay Area food banks ahead of the holiday season.
summary.mr: वर्षातील सर्वात मोठा अन्नदान उपक्रम, स्थानिक फूड बँकांच्या सहकार्याने.

label.en: Collection opens — drop off non-perishable goods

significance.en: "No being is separated from God; God exists in all and all exist in God." Annadan is the most direct form this teaching takes in our community.

whatToBring.en: Non-perishable food: rice, lentils, pasta, canned vegetables, cooking oil
Please check expiry dates — the food bank cannot accept expired goods

volunteerNeeds.en: Loading and transport — 4 volunteers with vehicles

summary.en: New blankets and warm clothing distributed to unhoused neighbours across San Jose through partner shelters.
summary.mr: सॅन होजे येथील निवाराहीन बांधवांसाठी नवीन घोंगड्या व उबदार कपडे.

significance.en: Maharaj asked that no one be turned away and no one be treated as lesser. This drive is the community's answer to a Bay Area winter.

whatToBring.en: New blankets only — used bedding cannot be accepted by shelters
New socks, gloves and caps are equally needed

summary.en: New, unwrapped toys collected for children in shelters and low-income families across Santa Clara County.
summary.mr: गरजू कुटुंबांतील मुलांसाठी नवीन खेळणी संकलन.

significance.en: Children who have very little are the first to be remembered in seva.

whatToBring.en: New toys, unwrapped, with original packaging

title.en: Shri Gajanan Maharaj Pragat Din Utsav
title.mr: श्री गजानन महाराज प्रगट दिन उत्सव

summary.en: The appearance day of Shri Gajanan Maharaj in Shegaon, observed on 23 February 1878. Our largest utsav of the year — palkhi, parayan, mahaprasad and cultural programme.
summary.mr: श्री गजानन महाराजांचा प्रगट दिन — वर्षातील सर्वात मोठा उत्सव. पालखी, पारायण, महाप्रसाद.

dateNote.en: Observance may be moved to the nearest weekend. The final date is confirmed in the January newsletter.

significance.en: On 23 February 1878, two residents of Shegaon found a young man by the roadside, picking grains from leftover food thrown out after a meal. What looked like madness was detachment. From that day Maharaj remained in Shegaon for thirty-two years, and Pragat Din marks the moment the community first saw him.

whatToBring.en: Flowers, fruit or a coconut for the offering, if you wish
Expect a large gathering — arrive early for parking

summary.en: The day devotees offer gratitude at the feet of the Guru. Padyapuja, parayan and mahaprasad.
summary.mr: गुरुचरणी कृतज्ञता अर्पण करण्याचा दिवस. पादुकापूजन, पारायण व महाप्रसाद.

dateNote.en: Date follows the panchang and is confirmed closer to the day.

significance.en: Guru Pournima is observed on the full moon of Ashadh. For devotees of Maharaj it is the day the relationship between the seeker and the Guru is renewed.

summary.en: Shri Gajanan Maharaj took Samadhi on 8 September 1910, on the day of Rishi Panchami. The day is observed with parayan and akhand nam jaap.
summary.mr: श्री गजानन महाराजांनी ८ सप्टेंबर १९१० रोजी ऋषिपंचमीच्या दिवशी समाधी घेतली.

significance.en: Maharaj himself chose the day. Devotees mark it not as a loss but as the completion of a life lived entirely for others.

summary.en: Backpacks, notebooks and stationery for students starting the school year in under-resourced districts.
summary.mr: गरजू विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी दप्तरे, वह्या व लेखनसाहित्य.

significance.en: Vidyadan is counted among the highest forms of dan. A child who has what they need on the first day of school starts the year level with everyone else.

whatToBring.en: New backpacks, notebooks, pens, pencils, crayons
